install.note: Use the current official download at https://www.dumate.cn/. Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon are offered; no official Linux desktop package is verified. Do not substitute another product or invent unattended installer flags.

install_flow.summary: Resolve and verify the official DuMate package for the current platform and architecture, install, then refresh detection.
agent_steps: Read https://www.dumate.cn/ for current HTTPS download links. Confirm the vendor supports the machine's OS and architecture before downloading to Downloads. Verify publisher signature and product identity; preserve the existing installation location.

Windows: install the signed DuMate x64 package. Use unattended flags only if verified; otherwise open the installer and report remaining user interaction. Resolve DuMate.exe under the installed product root, not dumate-main-server.exe. Verify resources/app.asar package.json name qianfan-desktop-app and version.

macOS: use the official Apple Silicon package and verify code signature/Gatekeeper. Install DuMate.app in Applications or the user's Applications folder and verify Contents/MacOS/DuMate and Contents/Resources/app.asar package identity. Do not claim Intel or Linux support without a current official package.
Refresh EchoBird detection and verify the installed executable path and version. A download alone does not establish installation success.
tell_user: Installed version and path, or the precise remaining installation step.

first_run.note: Open DuMate once to initialize native storage. Adding saves an account in EchoBird; applying switches the client. Quota refresh and daily reward claims are explicit actions. Monthly subscription points are issued by the vendor, not a separate EchoBird check-in. Custom model configuration is not supported.
